4. The suit was contested by defendant No.1 by filing written statement. The trial Court dismissed the suit by the judgment and decree dated 20.11.1992. On appeal being Title Appeal no.20 of 1998 the Appellate Court affirmed the' judgment and decree of the trial Court. The High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 2716 of 2000 also maintained the judgment and decree passed by the Appellate Court. 

 5. Heard Mr. Helal Uddin Molla, learned Advocate for the petitioners and Mr. Momtaz Uddin Fakir, learned Advocate who entered caveat on behalf of respondent No.1, perused the judgments and decrees of the Courts below and the impugned judgment and order.
